newsitem.title: GERMANY: Telekom surges five percent in IBIS trade.
newsitem.headline: Telekom surges five percent in IBIS trade.

text.p: Shares in German telecommunications giant Deutsche Telekom AG soared in otherwise lacklustre early dealings on Monday amid positive sentiment ahead of its annual news conference on Tuesday.
Telekom shares surged to an all-time high of 41.95 marks and were up 5.2 percent at 41.90 marks at 0721 GMT, while the IBIS DAX index was up 0.7 percent at 3,558.87 points.
Turnover in Telekom was the heaviest of the session.

One dealer said that a report in the magazine Der Spiegel that the company planned to move into commerical television and raise prices to bring its cable business into the black had been well received.
Dealers also said the gains were related to the imminent end of a six-month deadline on Telekom shares on May 19, from which date its shares can be sold without incurring tax.
Dealers said there was more upside potential on the stock, with some setting a short term goal of 42.50 marks.
